name: Should I hire separate trade specialists or a general remodeling contractor for a foreclosure rehab?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire separate trade specialists or a general remodeling contractor for a foreclosure rehab?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring individual independent contractors for each phase requires you to independently schedule drywallers, painters, carpenters, plumbers, and tile installers, which often creates coordination gaps and project delays. Working with an owner-operated general contractor provides a single point of contact who directs hands-on finish crews for framing, drywall, and painting while supervising licensed trade partners for plumbing and electrical work. This single-source structure avoids finger-pointing between trades, ensures baseboards and trim are installed only after flooring and paint are ready, and keeps the overall rehab timeline unified.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor provides a single point of contact to schedule framing, drywall, paint, and licensed sub-trades without coordination delays.
